segments.name: US East
segments.description: Casinos, hotels and racetracks in West Virginia and Maryland for gamblers and leisure guests.
segments.evidence: In addition to the casino and hotel, MTR has a golf course and a racetrack that holds live thoroughbred races from April to December.

segments.name: US Midwest
segments.description: Casinos and hotels in Missouri and Colorado for gamblers and leisure guests.
segments.evidence: CCV and our neighboring hotel, The Farmstead, are located in southeast Missouri along the Mississippi River approximately 95 miles north of Memphis, Tennessee.

segments.name: US West
segments.description: Casino resort in Reno-Sparks, Nevada operated for gamblers, convention and leisure guests.
segments.evidence: The Nugget is located in Reno-Sparks, Nevada on Interstate 80 approximately three miles from the Reno-Tahoe International Airport.

segments.name: Canada
segments.description: Casinos, racetracks and off-track betting facilities in Alberta, Canada for guests and bettors.
segments.evidence: CDR is located in Calgary, Alberta, seven miles from the Calgary International Airport.

segments.name: Poland
segments.description: Casinos operated throughout Poland under gaming licenses for gamblers.
segments.evidence: CPL has been in operation since 1989 and currently has six casino licenses throughout Poland.

revenueModel.text: Guests pay the company for casino gaming, hotel rooms, racing wagers, food and beverage, and entertainment.
revenueModel.evidence: Pari-mutuel revenue includes live racing, export, advanced deposit wagering and off-track betting.

changes.text: In the fourth quarter of 2025, the company reorganized its United States reportable segment into US East, US Midwest and US West.
changes.evidence: As a result, we reorganized our reportable segments to provide greater specificity within the United States.
